source.title: Forebears Uzbekistan forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to refresh common Uzbek given names and surnames. Gender buckets remain sample-level because they are not sourced from an official civil registry; transliteration is simplified to ASCII for product consistency.

source.title: ITU Uzbekistan national numbering plan communication of 10.II.2023

phones.notes: ITU confirms country code +998, nine-digit national significant numbers, and the listed mobile/GSM NDCs. Generated values are synthetic and are not checked for live subscriber assignment or portability.

locations.notes: UPU confirms six-digit postcodes before the locality and gives Tashkent/Samarkand address examples. The public postal-index order maps Tashkent city to 100XXX, Samarkand to 14XXXX, and Bukhara to 20XXXX. Street names and generated trailing postcode digits remain review data.

pinfl.label: Personal Identification Number
pinfl.notes: my.gov.uz confirms PINFL/JShShIR is a unique 14-digit number assigned to every individual in Uzbekistan. Generated values are random synthetic 14-digit numbers, not registry-checked, and no checksum or semantic digit logic is implemented.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Uzbekistan ordinary passport document entry

passport.notes: PRADO confirms the Uzbekistan ordinary passport document family, but the public entry reviewed does not confirm the visible passport-number grammar. The two letters plus seven digits template remains an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.
